expectations.text: Identifies that `id: number` + `workspaceId` tuple should be a single hierarchical `name` string
expectations.evidence: §4 says expose name: string e.g. workspaces/42/users/7

expectations.text: Identifies that verb-in-path (/get-user, /list-users, /user/new) should be resource-oriented paths
Identifies that POST /list-users should be GET on a resource path
expectations.evidence: §2 quote from AIP-130 about list being GET

expectations.text: Identifies that PUT for create should be POST
Identifies that PUT-full-replace for update should be PATCH-partial
expectations.evidence: §2 quote 'A full-replace PUT is almost never what callers want'

expectations.text: Identifies that enum members should be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE with _UNSPECIFIED zero value
Identifies that offset-based pagination should be cursor-based (limit + cursor)
expectations.evidence: §6 titled 'Pagination uses offset/limit instead of limit/cursor'

expectations.text: Cites at least two specific AIPs (e.g. AIP-121, AIP-126, AIP-130)
Provides a corrected version of the router (not just prose)
expectations.evidence: Each section contains corrected code; final corrected router included
